Results.ReviewText: We love our little gas grill, because it is easy to use and clean up! Our grilled meat taste great! It maybe for camping, but this is our everyday grill now! It may be small, but it preforms as one of the big guys!
Results.Title: Love The Size Of Our Weber Q1200 Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber.  First was Q1000, still working great. will use it at home.  Received  the Q1200 as a selected reward from my Credit Union.  I picked that item so I could leave one at home and carry the other in Motorhome.   Have had the Q1000 for 10 years still working great best out of approximately 6 or 7 different brands and types.  Thank you Weber.
Results.Title: Weber  Q 1200

Results.ReviewText: Meets the small patio bbq requirements for this octogenarian and my lovely wife.
Results.Title: https://product-images.weber.com/Grill-Images/Qs/5

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to do final assembly.  Quick to heat up. Makes beautiful sear marks and cooks food the quickest and most even I've ever had on a grill, to the degree I didn't know was possible based off of prior grills I've owned.  Cleanups a breeze with a wire grill brush.  Favorite part is the amazing flavor this grill provides, and absolutely no more flame up and burnt food! Even the wind doesn't affect the flame when the lids closed unlike other grills I've had of this size, as Weber put the air holes where wind can't enter the bottom and affect where the flame is.  They truly thought of everything.  1st Weber purchase and certainly won't be my last.
Results.Title: Truly won me over to Weber Grills.  Never go Back!

Results.ReviewText: The grill I purchased had a bolt on the side that holds the grill to the frame. Factory put the wrong screw inside and the frame is loose. I reached out to customer service and they sent a hardware set which includes a handle, a gas control knob, but not the correct parts. The screw is cross threaded and stuck in the grill so I am stuck with extra parts I can’t use and a grill with a loose frame!
Results.Title: Bad quality control

I wish there was a Bar-B-Que tool rack on the 1200 or a kit that could be added to the table. I also purchased the cast iron griddle for camping, but the one Weber offers is really too small for the Q1200. I use the Q1200 almost every day while camping.

Results.ReviewText:
This grill cooks perfectly, just follow the recommendations and the results are true. Remember to open the grill and turn out the trays! I bought the transportation station and the adapter for larger tanks as I primarily use it at home but have disposable canisters on the ready. It’s great with both. I supported the meat cooking for a part of 12 recently very easily and the cooking times, grill markings, inside outside texture contrast and flavors from the rolling smoke left nothing for desire! I will buy more as gifts in the future!
Happy Customer!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is phenomenal. I've used them at friends houses. I finally bought one and had a pool party. The food came out fantastic and the party was a hit. The grill heated up within a few minutes. Also, the tank of gas lasted over 4 hours, which is far longer than other table top grills I've bought. Let this be a lesson that the only grill is a Weber grill.

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and lightweight. This grill is super easy to maintain and grills foods perfectly. I like to use it for tailgating events.

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love this grill.  I have a smaller balcony that I wanted to split between lounging and outdoor cooking and this grill is the perfect size.  I'm really pleased with the amount of food I can grill on it at one time.  The food always comes out great and I haven't had any issues with items falling through the grill.  Temperature control is fantastic and with the accessory hose (sold separately) I can use a 20 lb propane tank, which makes life easier.  My only regret is buying the super light colored lid, because immediately some drips got cooked onto it and I haven't been able to clean them off.  :(. I wish forest green had been an option.
Results.Title: A Fantastic Compact Grill
